mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cps_issue ( agent_inspection_id, flow_version, status, factory, area, line, process, ai_category_l1_id, ai_category_l2_id, category_l1_id, category_l2_id, category_modified_flag, description, creator_emp_no, feedback_emp_no, responsible_emp_no, proof_emp_no, reviewer_emp_no, current_handler_emp_no, creator_emp_name, feedback_emp_name, responsible_emp_name, proof_emp_name, reviewer_emp_name, current_handler_emp_name, reason_analysis, corrective_measure, short_term_measure, long_term_measure, current_submission_version, inspection_item_id, rectify_remark, review_opinion, submit_time, close_time, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{agentInspectionId}, #{flowVersion}, #{status}, #{factory}, #{area}, #{line}, #{process}, #{aiCategoryL1Id}, #{aiCategoryL2Id}, #{categoryL1Id}, #{categoryL2Id}, #{categoryModifiedFlag}, #{description}, #{creatorEmpNo}, #{feedbackEmpNo}, #{responsibleEmpNo}, #{proofEmpNo}, #{reviewerEmpNo}, #{currentHandlerEmpNo}, #{creatorEmpName}, #{feedbackEmpName}, #{responsibleEmpName}, #{proofEmpName}, #{reviewerEmpName}, #{currentHandlerEmpName}, #{reasonAnalysis}, #{correctiveMeasure}, #{shortTermMeasure}, #{longTermMeasure}, #{currentSubmissionVersion}, #{inspectionItemId}, #{rectifyRemark}, #{reviewOpinion}, #{submitTime}, #{closeTime}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE cps_issue SET agent_inspection_id = #{agentInspectionId} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE cps_issue SET reviewer_emp_no = #{reviewerEmpNo}, reviewer_emp_name = #{reviewerEmpName}, current_handler_emp_no = #{reviewerEmpNo}, current_handler_emp_name = #{reviewerEmpName}, status = #{status}, lock_version = lock_version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE cps_issue SET status = #{status}, current_handler_emp_no = NULL, current_handler_emp_name = NULL, lock_version = lock_version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}

UPDATE cps_issue SET status = #{status}, responsible_emp_no = #{responsibleEmpNo}, proof_emp_no = #{proofEmpNo}, reviewer_emp_no = #{reviewerEmpNo}, current_handler_emp_no = #{currentHandlerEmpNo}, responsible_emp_name = #{responsibleEmpName}, proof_emp_name = #{proofEmpName}, reviewer_emp_name = #{reviewerEmpName}, current_handler_emp_name = #{currentHandlerEmpName}, reason_analysis = #{reasonAnalysis}, corrective_measure = #{correctiveMeasure}, short_term_measure = #{shortTermMeasure}, long_term_measure = #{longTermMeasure}, current_submission_version = #{currentSubmissionVersion}, inspection_item_id = #{inspectionItemId}, rectify_remark = #{rectifyRemark}, review_opinion = #{reviewOpinion}, category_l1_id = #{categoryL1Id}, category_l2_id = #{categoryL2Id}, category_modified_flag = #{categoryModifiedFlag}, close_time = #{closeTime}, lock_version = IFNULL(#{lockVersion}, 0) + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND lock_version = IFNULL(#{lockVersion}, 0)

where.if: AND (current_handler_emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{currentHandler}, '%') OR current_handler_emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{currentHandler}, '%'))
AND ( description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR current_handler_emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR current_handler_emp_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.sql: i.id, i.status, i.factory, i.area, i.line, i.process, i.ai_category_l1_id, i.ai_category_l2_id, i.category_l1_id, i.category_l2_id, i.description, i.current_handler_emp_no, i.current_handler_emp_name, i.submit_time, i.updated_at, i.creator_emp_no, i.creator_emp_name, i.feedback_emp_no, i.feedback_emp_name, i.reason_analysis, i.corrective_measure, i.rectify_remark, i.review_opinion, ai1.category_name AS ai_category_l1_name, ai2.category_name AS ai_category_l2_name, c1.category_name AS category_l1_name, c2.category_name AS category_l2_name, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(fl.operator_emp_no, '（', fl.operator_emp_name, '）') ORDER BY fl.created_at SEPARATOR '、') FROM cps_issue_flow_log fl WHERE fl.issue_id = i.id) AS all_flow_handlers, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(a.id ORDER BY a.sort_no SEPARATOR ',') FROM cps_issue_attachment a WHERE a.issue_id = i.id AND a.stage = 'ISSUE') AS issue_image_ids, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(a.id ORDER BY a.sort_no SEPARATOR ',') FROM cps_issue_attachment a WHERE a.issue_id = i.id AND a.stage = 'PROOF') AS proof_image_ids, CASE WHEN i.status <> 'CLOSED' AND i.submit_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue FROM cps_issue i LEFT JOIN cps_problem_category ai1 ON ai1.id = i.ai_category_l1_id LEFT JOIN cps_problem_category ai2 ON ai2.id = i.ai_category_l2_id LEFT JOIN cps_problem_category c1 ON c1.id = i.category_l1_id LEFT JOIN cps_problem_category c2 ON c2.id = i.category_l2_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM cps_issue WHERE status <> 'CLOSED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM cps_issue WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM cps_issue WHERE status <> 'CLOSED' AND submit_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM cps_issue WHERE status = 'CLOSED' AND close_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND close_time < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
